import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im16 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0016.png'))
# Frame 16 pose: x=0.5, y=1.5, yaw=90.0
# Plant pot in obs16 is on the left
mask_pot = (im16[:,:,0] > 120) & (im16[:,:,0] < 180) & (im16[:,:,1] > 50) & (im16[:,:,1] < 90) & (im16[:,:,2] < 50)
coords = np.argwhere(mask_pot)
coords = np.array([c for c in coords if c[1] < 100])
print('Pot min u:', coords[:,1].min(), 'max u:', coords[:,1].max())
print('Pot bottom v:', coords[:,0].max())
bottom_pot = coords[coords[:,0] == coords[:,0].max()]
print('Pot bottom u center:', bottom_pot[:,1].mean())
"
